payload.goal: Identify and prioritize the next zero-cost organic traffic actions after the P0 affiliate fix.

findings.evidence: Current projects/GlobalSaaSHub/index.html and live crawler fallback said 150 curated SaaS profiles, while merged PR #9 regression verification passed 151/151 tools and 151 pages and no later main commit removed a catalog tool.
findings.recommended_change: Change the static crawler fallback count from 150 to 151 or derive it from the catalog during generation so it cannot drift.

findings.evidence: The deployed gh-pages sitemap still carries 2026-07-27 lastmod values for pages such as vidIQ even though the page was updated and deployed on 2026-08-26.
findings.recommended_change: Regenerate lastmod from real page/data modification dates, or omit lastmod when a reliable date is unavailable.

findings.evidence: The crawler-visible homepage fallback contains descriptive text but no useful internal anchor links, while tool pages contain back/alternative links.
findings.recommended_change: Add a small crawler-visible set of category, high-intent comparison, and approved-monetization tool links to the static fallback.

findings.evidence: Static tool pages canonicalize to /tool/<slug>.html. Earlier verified live audits showed extensionless /tool/<slug> aliases also serving 200, so canonical tags mitigate but do not eliminate crawl duplication/wasted crawl budget.
findings.source_file: static tool routing / generated tool pages
findings.recommended_change: Normalize all internal links to .html canonical URLs and, where hosting allows, redirect extensionless aliases to the canonical URL.

findings.evidence: Tool pages expose alternatives, but the crawler fallback does not surface category/comparison hubs. Approved affiliate pages should be linked from relevant comparison/category contexts instead of relying mainly on sitemap discovery.
findings.recommended_change: Add contextual links among category, comparison and approved-affiliate tool pages; prioritize Taskade, Systeme.io, Fliki, Castmagic and vidIQ.

verified_good.robots: gh-pages/robots.txt allows all crawlers and points to https://coshuma.com/sitemap.xml
